newsitem.title: USA: Micron upgraded to buy from hold.
newsitem.headline: Micron upgraded to buy from hold.

text.p: Josephthal, Lyon & Ross analyst Larry Borgman said he upgraded Micron Technology Inc after some positive trends in memory chip pricing and some recent comment by Micron executives. Asia, there have been some positive statements by NEC and Samsung," Borgman said. "So we thought that DRAM prices have reached a bottom." Micron shares closed up one to 33-7/8.

Micron executives also said late Thursday that they had seen a slight uptick in DRAM pricing in January but they could not predict the trend going forward. DRAMs (dynamic random access memory) chips are the biggest chip component of PCs.
